descriptionHtml:
Decision D6 · P1 · Daniela

Transcript / retention windows differ from UAT 3.6 in ways no ticket AC settles: archive 48 h (not 36), 'Earlier sessions' and 'Most Recent' are undated, Quick Dictation boxes never expire, windows are hard-coded (make them configurable?); the Nursing Home course card shows the last 3 visits (UAT 3.6 says 2) (Q5)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-16/S23, TC-16/S27, OAT-04/S19, TC-11/S28, TC-04/S10

Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S07 Nursing Home visit counts 0 / 1 / 3 / 4, with skipped days

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)
  • U4 Nursing Home: entries are keyed by visit number and labelled 'Visit N – date'. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 5)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Four seeded residents. R0: no course. R1: one visit (<day-4>). R3: visits on <day-4>, <day-2> and <day0> (day-3 and day-1 skipped). R4: four visits (<day-6>, <day-4>, <day-2>, <day0>)

When Open each resident's Pre-Round tab and look at the Visit Timeline (view only)

Then R0: no visit entry and no filler line. R1: 'Visit 1 – <day-4>'. R3: Visits 2 and 3 in date order, nothing for day-3 or day-1. R4: Visits 3 and 4 in order. Whether R3 Visit 1 and R4 Visits 1–2 must still show depends on Q5 (all / last 3 / last 2)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint, scoped to the Visit Timeline. The display label 'Visit N – <date>' is judged, not the stored '·'. Only visits shown under every Q5 reading are judged (R3 Visits 2–3, R4 Visits 3–4); R3 Visit 1 and R4 Visits 1–2 go in notJudged (Q5). …
